note: Red River County is in Texas, where counties do not zone. The only city with a zoning ordinance found is Clarksville City (ecode360 No. 2018-001), whose Zoning District Map is adopted by reference and kept in the City Manager's office; no queryable GIS, ArcGIS REST service or downloadable file of its districts was found. No zoning layer appeared in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for the county, and Bogata, Detroit and Annona showed no zoning publications. The maps.townofclarksville.com zoning service belongs to the Town of Clarksville (a different jurisdiction), so it was not used.
